definition: Arachnoid granulations are structures involved in reabsorbing cerebrospinal fluid. When this reabsorption is impaired, cerebrospinal fluid can build up in the brain’s ventricles, leading to communicating hydrocephalus.

provenance.scope: Source record C34501; pinned source text
